ops.body:
2026-07-26 ~09:20Z — USER VERDICTS + plan reshape.

User picked: (1) fix BOTH helper bugs now (session-type + Caskroom staging), full scope; (2) yasyf box stays DARK by choice — watcher armed, sweep resumes automatically on reappearance, no physical intervention for now (peer registration from home stays parked accordingly).

Ownership correction from the fix lane's source-read: daemonkit never emits LimitLoadToSessionType — synckit (daemon/service.go:87, which also owns canonicalHelperProgram and thus BOTH bugs), captain-hook (internal/hookd/deployment.go:176/:182 + persisted policy), and cc-notes (internal/helperdeployment/deployment_identity.go:345) are the emitters. Consequence: the daemonkit RELEASE FREEZE CAN HOLD — consumer releases carry the fixes (synckit v0.36.3, captain-hook 12.20.11, cc-notes v0.47.11 expected) unless the staging fix demands a daemonkit API change (lane checks back if so; only then a targeted v0.20.7).

Ratified uniform mapping (all three consumers): Background-family session types → ProcessType Background; Aqua → dropped (no analogue; redundant in gui domain; live SSH-context risk since machines upgrade over SSH). Three implementation lanes dispatched in parallel (/tmp/repin-wave workspaces, no-commit, ship gated on review). Machine convergence path once released: brew upgrade synckit → synckitd install regenerates correct helper plists (replacing the hand-stripped interim ones); brew upgrade captain-hook → helper bootstraps → the stuck 12.20.x app delivery completes; cc-notes upgrade fixes the fusekit helper emission. Backlog tasks 574ba471 + 74be91d7 annotated with the corrections.
